scope: Design-stage adjudication by exact measurement, entirely target-free; no preregistered data-bearing arm was ever launched.
verdict: The additive t=25..30 pair-series tail is cost-admissible (36.4e9 of 67.3e9) and numerically stable, but effect-capped at about 1.6e-5 of the final error scale (aligned MSE effect bound about 8e-5): the truncated Mehler tail is not where the host error lives, and the S receipt's t=24 born-error correlation was co-location through bond strength, not causation. The arm cannot move raw MSE measurably; the node closes at design with no data-bearing launch.
standing_evidence: The quartic-star birth marker (+0.335) survives this closure and points at the Edgeworth weight expansion order (pair weights stop at 1 + L3 + L4 + L3^2/2); any successor must first measure its own marginal einsum billing and target-free effect size under this same protocol.
